title: Checking the conditions of the stretch you chose
description: Boundaries, restrictions and information about campsites are read together with where they came from and how old they are.

blocks.text: A drawn line does not explain which rules apply on the ground.

quote.text: Works great, would be better if it worked with CarPlay when I’m looking for dispersed campsites and need to figure out land ownership.

blocks.text: Gather the available information by stretch, provide a way through to the primary sources, and mark where data is missing. Save it along with the plan.
Conditions can change; a map should not pass a missing marker off as permission.
